title: Hexion Specialty Chemicals Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of Orica Australia Limited's formaldehyde resins business

timeline.event: ACCC commences review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines. Market inquiries commence
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
Having regard to the submissions received, the proposed date for ACCC findings has been revised from 13 October to 18 October.
Proposed announcement delayed until 25 October (delay requested by Hexion to allow for provision of additional information).
Proposed announcement delayed to allow for further inquiries.

ACCC published a Statement of Issues outlining preliminary competition concerns.  Proposed date for announcement of ACCC findings delayed to allow for market consultation on the ACCC's Statement of Issues.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties
ACCC decided not to oppose the proposed acquisition.
